$comment: Multi-source cases (spec §15.1). Evaluated from Phase 5, when federation exists. 'sources' lists corpus roots; corpus-mirror plays a second source exposing unity.kb.

cases.notes: Identical copies collapse into one result listing both sources, with no conflict.
The mirror copy differs, so the result reports two revisions.

cases.query: version the format of persisted data
cases.notes: The small mirror's best result (JsonUtility, which only mentions format versions in passing) must not outrank the large source's excellent result. Rank interleaving alone could put it first.
